selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Why did the traveler begin a new journey?
questions.answer: He wanted to learn the proofs that show Allah is One.

questions.question: What had the traveler already done before this new journey?
questions.answer: He had thought about the whole universe and asked about his Creator so he could find Allah with strong certainty.

questions.question: Who did the traveler speak to before starting again?
questions.answer: He spoke to his intellect.

questions.question: At the first stopping-place, how many holy truths did they see?
questions.answer: They saw four sacred truths.

questions.question: What did those four truths show very clearly?
questions.answer: They clearly showed the oneness of Allah.

questions.question: How do blessings in the universe affect people?
questions.answer: They encourage people to thank, praise, and worship Allah.

questions.question: What does the third truth say about the universe’s wisdom and beauty?
questions.answer: They are clear signs that real perfection exists.

questions.question: What parts of the universe show these perfections?
questions.answer: Its order, beauty, justice, and wisdom show them.

questions.question: What was the traveler’s goal in being sent to the world?
questions.answer: His goal was to reach faith.

questions.question: What did he search for everywhere?
questions.answer: He searched for his Sustainer and wanted to find Allah.

questions.question: What new topic did he want to study after reaching certainty about Allah’s existence?
questions.answer: He wanted to study the proofs of Allah’s unity.

questions.question: Who went with the traveler on this journey?
questions.answer: His intellect went with him.

questions.question: What was special about the four truths they saw there?
questions.answer: They were spread over the whole universe and clearly pointed to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What feeling should gifts and blessings in the universe awaken in people?
questions.answer: They should awaken thankfulness, praise, and worship.

questions.question: Why do blessings matter in the proof of divinity?
questions.answer: Because they lead people to gratitude and worship.

questions.question: Why does the first truth rule out partners with Allah?
questions.answer: Because the One who deserves worship cannot share that right with others.

questions.question: In this passage, what is the main subject of the Second Chapter?
questions.answer: It is about proofs that show Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What kind of certainty had the traveler reached before starting this new part of the journey?
questions.answer: He had reached certainty that his Creator truly exists.

questions.question: What did the traveler ask all things about?
questions.answer: He asked them about his Creator.

questions.question: What did the traveler and his intellect see ruling over the whole cosmos at the first stop?
questions.answer: They saw four sacred truths.

questions.question: What do these truths make necessary?
questions.answer: They make Allah’s oneness necessary.

questions.question: Which features of the universe are named as signs of perfection?
questions.answer: Its wisdom, beauty, justice, and meaningful aims are named.

questions.question: What does the first truth teach about worship?
questions.answer: It teaches that worship belongs only to Allah.

questions.question: What qualities of the universe are listed as signs of this perfection?
questions.answer: Wisdom, beauty, justice, and purposeful order are listed.
